info.description:
# CustomerCheck
The Nextcloud-native command center for customer work: one place where a workspace shares a customer book, shared mailbox, account plans, and operating rituals — so the team can see what’s going on, decide what’s next, chase deals and renewals, coach the team, and measure the book by joining Check apps and Groupware.
Not Salesforce. Ledgers stay in ProjectCheck, InvoiceCheck, TicketCheck, Files, Mail, Tasks.
## Highlights
- **Today / Pulse / Brief** — act now, measure the book, weekly owned commitments - **Company 360** — Ten Command Questions with honest sibling mute reasons - **Workspaces** — roles, switcher, fail-closed directory allowlists - **My Chase & Pipeline** — next action, quote age, sequences, loss codes, forecast labels (not cash) - **KAM coverage** — buying roles, next touch, customer promises, prepare meeting - **Team coaching** — stuck board, OOO backup (non-stealing), bulk reassign - **Universal Review & Conflicts** — shared mail + platform candidates; three-way edit conflicts with reason - **Renewal engine** — 60/30/7/0/+7 exactly-once remlog + ICS - **Shared mailbox** — folder IMAP + SMTP send with unavoidable shared disclosure - **Check Partner hours** — 15-minute quota log with 80 % alert - **Integrations** — optional ProjectCheck, InvoiceCheck, TicketCheck, SbdLicenseOps - **Accessibility** — WCAG 2.1 AA; responsive from 320 px · EN + DE - **Web free (AGPL)** — companion seats never gate the web app
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 32–34 - PHP 8.2+ - MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL

# CustomerCheck
Das Nextcloud-native Kommandozentrum für Kundenarbeit: ein Arbeitsbereich teilt Kundenbuch, gemeinsames Postfach, Account-Pläne und Betriebsrituale — damit das Team sieht, was läuft, entscheidet was als Nächstes dran ist, Deals und Verlängerungen chase’t, coacht und das Buch misst, indem Check-Apps und Groupware verbunden werden statt sie zu ersetzen.
Kein Salesforce. Buchungen bleiben in ProjectCheck, InvoiceCheck, TicketCheck, Files, Mail, Tasks.
## Highlights
- **Today / Pulse / Brief** — jetzt handeln, Buch messen, wöchentliche Zusagen - **Company 360** — Zehn Kommandfragen mit ehrlichen Mute-Gründen bei fehlenden Apps - **Arbeitsbereiche** — Rollen, Umschalter, restriktive Freigabelisten - **My Chase & Pipeline** — nächste Aktion, Angebotsalter, Sequenzen, Verlustcodes, Forecast-Labels (kein Cash) - **KAM-Coverage** — Buying Roles, Next Touch, Kundenversprechen, Meeting-Vorbereitung - **Team-Coaching** — Stuck-Board, OOO-Vertretung (ohne Ownership-Diebstahl), Bulk-Reassign - **Verlängerungs-Engine** — 60/30/7/0/+7 genau-einmal Remlog + ICS - **Gemeinsames Postfach** — Ordner-IMAP + SMTP mit unvermeidbarer Shared-Kennzeichnung - **Check-Partner-Stunden** — 15-Minuten-Kontingent mit 80-%-Warnung - **Integrationen** — optional ProjectCheck, InvoiceCheck, TicketCheck, SbdLicenseOps - **Barrierefreiheit** — WCAG 2.1 AA; responsiv ab 320 px · DE + EN - **Web frei (AGPL)** — Companion-Sitze sperren die Web-App nie
